body:
The leaves can be used as a stimulant, spiritual ally, and health aid simultaneously; I have chewed the sacred leaf for all of these occasions.  While under the trance of differing entheogens  Peruvian Torch, DXM, morning glory  coca helps with nausea and general bodily funkiness, while granting a certain lucidity and strength that is well needed during these all-night vigils.
I obtained llipta, alkaline plant ash from Peru, which I chew with the coca to activate the alkaloids.  Ones mouth grows numb which feels a bit nice as the coca infusion seeps into ones veins
I have only tried cocaine once, and it isnt in the same league as coca It felt nice enough, but its effects felt a bit poisonous, as synthetics often do.  And the more plants I am immersed in, the less interest I have in chemical synthetics
Oh, and coca is SUPERB for long, steep hikes, which I often do here in the Pacific Northwest.  Sometimes I bring only minimal food if its a day hike.	Knock on the door and the plant healers will answer. Coca is the shamanic plant par excellence.
[Reported Dose: "quid - 10-20 leaves"]
